name: Midpoint Reparameterization
description: Transforms the standard interval scheduling/packing constraints into an algebraically equivalent system based on interval midpoints. Instead of expressing conditions as `start >= 0` and `start + length <= T`, it requires `center - length/2 >= 0` and `center + length/2 <= T`, with non-overlap expressed as `|center1 - center2| >= (length1 + length2)/2`. This perfectly preserves the underlying math and answers while defeating LLMs that rely on surface-level pattern matching of `length1 + length2 > T` or `sum(lengths) > T`.
